correctness.rationale: The three occupation classes have the stated exact transition rates, reversible binomial stationary weights, and per-state successful-hop escape rates. The stationary Poisson equation Qh=mu-lambda has h_1=0 and h_0=1-mu/(2m),h_2=1-mu/(2n), with inaccessible states contributing zero. Analytic tilt Q_z=e^z W-Lambda gives F=1+(2/mu)<lambda-mu,h>_pi. Detailed balance makes the excess sum of two nonnegative squares; exact algebra yields [N²+(m-n)²(N²-6N+4)]/[N²(N-1)²]. Equality occurs only for K_{1,3}, where constant intensity 2 proves the whole count process Poisson. Sign of N²-6N+4 proves the 4,5 versus >=6 ordering. Independently constructed full-configuration generators match 35 parameter pairs, exact symbolic algebra two identities, and 28 order cases. Finite checks are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: This determines a physically natural, measurable stationary dynamical activity fluctuation exactly for every finite complete bipartite graph with two hard-core particles. The complete reversal of optimal graph shape between orders five and six and the unique all-time Poisson star are nontrivial structural classifications not implied merely by the uniform equilibrium law or mean rate. Sharp balanced-versus-star noise scales distinguish high-connectivity graphs from hubs. The result is not a routine relabelling or an arbitrary numerical slice.
